`@x18n/lsp` is the language server that the VS Code extension uses. Any editor with an LSP client can run it:

```sh
pnpx x18n-lsp --stdio
```

The server also accepts `--node-ipc` and `--socket=<port>`. It loads the projects of each workspace folder, the same way the CLI does.

## Standard features

The server treats keys as symbols. It supports go to definition, go to implementation, references, rename (with prepare), hover, inlay hints, completion of keys, code actions (quick fixes and extraction), document symbols, workspace symbols, code lenses and diagnostics. Diagnostics are the same as the ones from `x18n check`.

## Initialization options

The client passes these fields in `initializationOptions`. Each one is optional.

```ts
interface Settings {
  annotationMaxLength: number
  displayLocale: string | undefined
  codeLens: boolean
  /** Flag emoji next to locales in hovers. */
  showFlags: boolean
}
```

## Custom methods

Shapes follow the [JSON contract](/references/json-contracts) version. Positions and ranges use LSP conventions: zero-based lines and UTF-16 characters.

| Method | Kind | Params | Result | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x18n/projects` | request |  | `ProjectInfo[]` | The projects of the workspace. |
| `x18n/keyAt` | request | `PositionParams` | `KeyAtResult \| null` | The key or key prefix at a position, in code or in a locale file. |
| `x18n/tree` | request | `TreeParams` | `TreeNode[]` | One level of the key tree, with translation counts. |
| `x18n/progress` | request |  | `ProgressResult` | Translation progress per project and locale. |
| `x18n/fileKeys` | request | `DocumentParams` | `FileKeysResult` | The keys and hard strings of one file. |
| `x18n/usageReport` | request |  | `UsageReportResult` | Unused keys, and used keys that are not defined. |
| `x18n/decorations` | request | `DocumentParams` | `DecorationsResult` | The ranges and values for in-place annotations in a source file. |
| `x18n/setDisplayLocale` | notification (client to server) | `SetDisplayLocaleParams` |  | Changes the display locale. The server refreshes the inlay hints. |
| `x18n/openUi` | request | `OpenUiParams` | `OpenUiResult` | Starts the UI server for a project on loopback and returns its URL and a one-time auth token. |
| `x18n/translatePrompt` | request | `TranslatePromptParams` | `string` | The translate prompt for a locale, as markdown. |
| `x18n/changed` | notification (server to client) | `ChangedParams` |  | A project changed. `keys` lists the keys that changed. |

## Commands

The server runs these through `workspace/executeCommand`. The argument is one object. `project` defaults to the first project.

| Command | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x18n.set` | `{ project?, key, locale?, value }` | Sets one value. `locale` defaults to the source locale. |
| `x18n.delete` | `{ project?, key, locale? }` | Deletes a key in one locale, or in all locales. |
| `x18n.renamePrefix` | `{ project?, key, to }` | Renames every key under a prefix, in locale files and code. |
| `x18n.extract` | `{ uri }` | Extracts every hard string of a file. |
| `x18n.migrateI18nAlly` | `{ uri }` | Returns the files that the migration from i18n-ally writes, as `MigrationResult`. Nothing is written. |

## Types

```ts
export interface Position {
  readonly line: number
  readonly character: number
}

export interface Range {
  readonly start: Position
  readonly end: Position
}

export interface Location {
  readonly uri: string
  readonly range: Range
}

export interface DocumentParams {
  readonly uri: string
}

export interface PositionParams extends DocumentParams {
  readonly position: Position
}

export interface ProjectInfo {
  readonly name: string
  readonly root: string
  readonly sourceLocale: string
  readonly locales: readonly { readonly code: string, readonly displayName: string | undefined, readonly flag: string | undefined }[]
  readonly displayLocale: string
  readonly keys: number
}

export interface KeyAtResult {
  readonly project: string
  readonly key: string
  readonly type: 'key' | 'subtree'
  readonly range: Range
}

export interface TreeParams {
  readonly project?: string | undefined
  /** Parent key; omitted for the roots. */
  readonly parent?: string | undefined
}

export interface TreeNode {
  readonly key: string
  readonly label: string
  readonly leaf: boolean
  readonly translated: number
  readonly total: number
  /** Display-locale value for leaves. */
  readonly value: string | undefined
}

export interface LocaleProgress {
  readonly locale: string
  readonly translated: number
  readonly total: number
  readonly missing: readonly string[]
  readonly empty: readonly string[]
}

export interface ProgressResult {
  readonly projects: readonly { readonly name: string, readonly locales: readonly LocaleProgress[] }[]
}

export interface FileKey {
  readonly key: string
  readonly range: Range
  readonly value: string | undefined
  readonly missing: boolean
  readonly dynamic: boolean
}

export interface FileKeysResult {
  readonly keys: readonly FileKey[]
  readonly hardStrings: readonly { readonly text: string, readonly range: Range }[]
}

export interface UsageReportResult {
  readonly unused: readonly { readonly project: string, readonly key: string, readonly location: Location | undefined }[]
  readonly missing: readonly { readonly project: string, readonly key: string, readonly locations: readonly Location[] }[]
}

export interface Decoration {
  readonly range: Range
  /** The whole call holding the key, when the scanner knows it. */
  readonly expression?: Range | undefined
  readonly key: string
  readonly value: string | undefined
  readonly state: 'ok' | 'missing' | 'dynamic'
}

export interface DecorationsResult {
  readonly locale: string
  readonly decorations: readonly Decoration[]
}

export interface SetDisplayLocaleParams {
  readonly locale: string | undefined
}

export interface OpenUiParams {
  readonly project?: string | undefined
}

export interface OpenUiResult {
  readonly url: string
  readonly token: string
}

export interface TranslatePromptParams {
  readonly project?: string | undefined
  readonly locale: string
  readonly keys?: readonly string[] | undefined
}

export interface ChangedParams {
  readonly project: string
  readonly revision: number
  readonly keys: readonly string[]
}

export interface MigrationResult {
  readonly files: readonly MigrationFile[]
  /** What was dropped or needs attention, for the report. */
  readonly notes: readonly string[]
  /** i18n-ally settings that can be removed after the migration. */
  readonly removable: readonly string[]
}

export interface MigrationFile {
  /** Path relative to the project root. */
  readonly path: string
  readonly content: string
}
```
